title: Count supplier aging evidence by selected page grouping
description: A purchasing user chooses a finite grouping of the currently authorized dynamic supplier-aging evidence page and sees invoice counts without changing source records. Development only; reuse ERP-140 authorized, bounded read-only supplier-aging preview and existing HTTP audit. Work solely on the current page. Preserve explicit unknown due dates, invalid/unknown allocation evidence, draft/void separation and currency isolation. Missing permission or invalid grouping fails closed. No new schema, migration, production SQL, real database execution, payment action, ledger inference, arbitrary SQL, business writes, secrets/.env or deployment. Verify focused tests and safe Release build/test; no real-browser acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: API accepts only none/supplier/currency/agingBucket/allocationState group keys and rejects other values before source reads.
Preview returns deterministic current-page invoice counts for selected grouping, keeps unknown due date and invalid/unknown allocation classes visible, and never sums different currencies or amounts.
Unit tests cover allowed and denied users, all grouping keys, unknown evidence, empty/paged results and no writes; document page-only count semantics.
